hints.title: Bound Maximum Reachable Index
hints.text: Because we must return to index 0 within steps moves, we can never wander farther than steps / 2 positions.

hints.title: Sum Three Possible Source Moves
hints.text: Ways to reach position p at step s equals remaining in place, coming from p - 1, or coming from p + 1.

hints.title: Roll Two DP Arrays Modulo 10^9 + 7
hints.text: Use two 1D arrays of size min(steps / 2 + 1, arrLen) to update ways round by round modulo 1000000007.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Branching 3 ways per step produces 3^steps paths.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bounding the maximum coordinate to steps // 2 restricts active states to at most 251.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should prune array length to steps // 2 + 1 to prevent allocating up to arrLen = 10^6.
